**Observations from test image:**
- Close-up of a soybean stem node
- Grayish-white fluffy/cottony growth at the node junction
- Surrounding leaves are yellowed
- Stem appears green but with visible mold at the node

**Comparison with White Mold reference:**
- The reference clearly shows white/gray fluffy cottony growth on soybean stems at nodes — this matches perfectly
- The symptom description: "fluffy, white growth on soybean stems with gray to white lesions at nodes" exactly matches the gray fluffy growth visible at the node in the test image

This is a strong match for White Mold (Sclerotinia stem rot). The fluffy gray-white mycelial growth at the node is the characteristic diagnostic feature.
